rawContent: If you can't protest but want to help, consider donating- if you can't donate, consider having a (potentially uncomfortable, but civil) conversation with a friend or family member who feels differently- help them understand why this is important. #BlackLivesMatter

The term 'white privilege' does not mean that all white people live well- you can be destitute or mistreated regardless of skin color. What it means is that you are not as likely to be mistreated *because* of your skin. Don't deny that it exists. #BlackLivesMatter

In twenty or so years, when a child, grandchild, or great-grandchild asks, 'We talked about 2020 in class today- what were you doing then?' what is your answer going to be, and are you proud of it? #BlackLivesMatter make sure you vote.

When saying the phrase 'a few bad apples,' remember to finish the addage as written: 'ruin the bunch.' The problem is that if a 9 good cops are willing to let 1 bad cop slide because they're coworkers, they've all become bad. #BlackLivesMatter #DefundThePolice
Bettie Jones answered the door to let Chicago police officers in to help her upstairs neighbor, who had called 911 to resolve a domestic dispute.   #SayTheirNames #BlackLivesMatter
Whether you want to protest, sign a petition, or just better understand what's happening right now, the Black Lives Matter site has a lot of good resources. https://t.co/gGLRQHwRA2 #BlackLivesMatter

As a white man, I will say if you don't want to acknowledge white privilege because it's uncomfortable to feel like the world is perpetually in your favor, even during personal hardship, I'm sorry, but it exists- use privilege you have to do good in the world. #BLM
